# komodo_variable (Data Source)

Fetches a Komodo global variable by name.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "komodo_variable" "docker_root" {
  name = "DOCKER_ROOT"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Variable name.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description shown in the Komodo UI.
- `is_secret` (Boolean) Whether the variable is marked as a secret.
- `value` (String, Sensitive) Variable value. For a secret variable read with a non-admin API key, Komodo returns a mask of '#' characters instead of the value.
